title: acd: Transfers stalling when copying from ACD to crypted ACD
body:
For some reason my transfer kept stalling out while copying to an encrypted drive as seen in the picture below. Another user also reported the issue when transferring to an encrypted remote on google drive.


> What is your rclone version (eg output from `rclone -V`)
rclone v1.34-23-gc41b67eβ

> Which OS you are using and how many bits (eg Windows 7, 64 bit)
CentOS 7 64bit

> Which cloud storage system are you using? (eg Google Drive)
Amazon Cloud Drive although another person using google reported the same issue

> The command you were trying to run (eg `rclone copy /tmp remote:tmp`)
rclone copy remote:/stuff encryptedremote:/stuff

> A log from the command with the `-v` flag (eg output from `rclone -v copy /tmp remote:tmp`)
rclone -v copy /tmp amazon:tmp
